caption: The drawing features a single sculptural object rendered in a light, almost white hue on a solid blue-gray background. The object is a detailed figurehead, resembling the upper portion of a woman dressed in elaborate, layered garments that include ruffles and a tightly fitted bodice with ornate decorations. The woman’s head is tilted slightly upward, and her hair is styled in an intricate fashion. Her arms are drawn close to her sides, with one arm partially visible. The base of the figure turns into a scroll-like decorative motif, often seen at the prow of a ship. The entire composition is executed in a stippled or textured illustration style, giving the appearance of depth and dimension. There are no other objects or features in the composition aside from the figurehead and the plain background.
title: Figurehead
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
